create_dataset_instance: create a UCTDataset instance with config, train_videos, and all_features for QFVS video summarization
getitem_dataset_sample: get a dataset sample by index returning features, tokens, masks, and ground truth tensors
tokenize_concept_prompts: tokenize concept prompts using RobertaTokenizer to generate input_ids and attention_mask tensors for query-focused video summarization
load_oracle_summaries: load oracle summary ground truth shots from text files and convert to binary tensor representation
compute_concept_ground_truth: compute concept ground truth tensors by matching concepts against per-shot dense tags from video annotation files
